title: Exact Color Caulking | GenStone
description: GenStone exact color match caulking is used to quickly conceal fastener holes left in ledgers, trim, pillar caps and the face of the panels.
text:

GenStone Caulking Kit

Home Finishes GenStone Caulking Kit
One color match caulking kit is suggested for every 400 square feet of GenStone installed. Our color match caulking can be tinted to the exact color needed to fill in and conceal fastener holes in the face of the panels, ledgers and trim. A paint kit is needed to tint the caulking and we advise purchasing one extra paint kit in addition to paint intended for touchups.
